parsed.why: Strong constitutional equality, hate-crime law, and a 2025 binding detention-care ruling, but township violence, contested facility access and police mockery offset them; no criminalisation, remedies largely function.

Conduct statute actively used to arrest trans people for gender expression, police genital forced-display, outing campaigns, no recognition or anti-discrimination law, official hostility, blocked organisations; state-tolerated targeting with no recourse.

Self-ID with X marker, protected bathrooms, hate-crime and equality redress operating, foreign LGBT+ travel guidance, ranked top internationally; only small rising raw hate-crime counts and minor residual friction.

Penal code criminalising same-sex conduct with lashes, extended to all persons, restrictive UN posture, no recognition or protections, documented hate crimes including against perceived transgender people, thin trans record; criminalising state with no relief.

Explicit 2020 bar on legal gender change and official threat-framing laws and statements persist, but same-sex conduct legal, partnerships and large Pride operate, EU rulings strike laws, no documented visitor-facing violence or facility ban.
